channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Puerto Rico's leadership took its investment pitch to Wall Street this period, ringing the NYSE opening bell to promote the Act 60 tax-incentive extension through 2055 and citing roughly $2.6 billion in reshoring investment across some 25-29 manufacturing projects and 5,000+ jobs, including a $46 million Taiwanese biopharma facility under construction. Retail and hospitality kept signaling confidence, with Burger King's $2.5 million relocation, Dunkin's planned 2027 return, Walmart's $20 million Mayagüez land purchase, a $15.3 million Plaza Las Américas mall acquisition, and expanded Disney/Norwegian cruise homeporting in San Juan.
